shared_file_ports: AdoptionHooks._state (strict ordinal direct index and owner/is checks)
AdoptionHooks.store_scalar/store_count (first-cell before guarded fold; preserve raw diagnostics/axes)
FilePortView._call (per-file reserved quota/index registration before invoke)
FilePortView.acquire (exact-path canonical lookup; same descriptor/type refusal)

choice: Only remove hot scans and add exact derived accounting with explicit failure quarantine. No production/full-roster/storage/streaming/entry change.

complexity.authority: Canonical raw records always retained. Indices/contributions are source-owned derived state, never a serialized ready/verified flag or substitute for raw observations.
complexity.hot: handle, healthy read_known, _state and Read reservation/admission are O(1) in total prior calls; len/direct indexed lookup allowed. Per-axis fold O(1). No call-list iteration/membership/copy or disguised base-list/dict.values traversal.
complexity.report: One O(N+r) canonical pass per explicit snapshot/packet/report/consistency window, then O(1) per-file lookups. Source must not invoke rebuild/report in read work to hide a scan. Fixed existing publication count stays bounded; not an empirical full-roster fit claim.

later_distinct: Streaming/noncapture payload path or changed chunk/query witness retention
Larger bounded logical ledger/publication format and production metadata admission
Self-hosting three source files, trusted first-entry Origin/class adoption and real14-export/physical sink binding

precode_controls.fault_injection: No new public TestHooks/API. Future private helpers may be wrapped by independent harness before/after delegated body. V2 baseline instruments actual append/store_count boundaries rather than treating absent future methods as failure. Test-only patching is not production authority.
precode_controls.instrumentation: CountingList installed as actual empty Registry._calls at construction, same owner/list thereafter; count __iter__/__contains__ element visits and ordinary len/getitem. No direct base-list bypass, copied ledger or fake guard results.
precode_controls.owner: Grammar independently freezes protocol +3..6 actual controls before V3 implementation; Native reviews this design/test boundary
precode_controls.parity: Unchanged48+same8+author12+supplement4, plus independently frozen complexity/fault controls. Metric windows exclude explicitly declared report/cleanup rebuild windows, never hidden hot scans. No timing/performance green threshold.

clean read_known access global-call-list visits (V2 scans, indexed0)
actual AdoptionHooks._state membership on valid source-issued ref (V2 membership visits, indexed0)
actual per-file Read admission through valid-world binding (V2 global quota visits, indexed0)
canonical append / reserved-index failure BEFORE invoke: exact original error, rawUNOBSERVED/invocationFalse/read_unknownFalse, known prior handle closes once

defined-count fold beforecommit/aftercommit + partialscalar/identical-replay variants: raw known58 retained/hash0/capture0/countauxFalse/originalMemory; canonical reports no doubling or healing; unhealthy work getter refuses; normal identical healthy facts add once

private_methods.purpose: After authoritative calls.append and BEFORE call.invoked/binding: validate owner+ordinal/list[ordinal] is call, apply direct per-file open/close pointer or Read reservation once. Committed identical reapplication is no-op; unfinished apply is not retried.

Called only for ReadFile immediately AFTER valid first scalar/count assignment (also identical re-store), before auxiliary acknowledgments. Derive contribution only from existing defined(call). Undefined pair remains pending/None. Defined pair prepares bounded new total, sets applying/contribution, updates file total, then committed. Committed same contribution is no-op, never added twice.

Outer callers catch BaseException around registration/fold including a wrapper throwing after helper returns. Store original fault and call.stopped before diagnostic formatting, retain existing original-primary/secondary identity rules, propagate same original error. Use existing pre_dispatch/after_scalar_before_aux/after_count_before_aux phases, no new public enum.

If accounting fault exists, refuse all new noncleanup work with retained primary/original fault, BEFORE dispatch/cached totals/gates; never scan or heal. Integrate into check(cleanup=False). check(cleanup=True) still enforces original hardclock for legal once cleanup.

One O(N+r) pass over authoritative records into per-file and per-API views; preserve full raw records, known/undefined/wrapper axes and public fields. Read-only reporting after failure derives truth even if cache partly applied. compare_cache=True only at existing consistency gate with original work checks; mismatch fails existing INVALID_INPUT/consistency. No cache repair/clear-fault/positive readiness output.

fields._calls: UNCHANGED authoritative append-only canonical ordinal list; no duplicate ordinal map or alternative record authority
fields._file_by_exact_path: dict exact admitted path -> SAME canonical FileState; <=4, populated during admission before IO
fields._files: UNCHANGED authoritative file-id list; O(1) identity check uses files[id] is state

fields._close_call: None or SAME canonical CallState, installed before close invoke; once-only
fields._known_read_bytes: derived committed sum0..spec.size; usable for WORK only when no accounting fault
fields._open_call: None or SAME canonical CallState, installed before open invoke
fields._read_reservations: 0..Ri conservatively consumed for created Read records BEFORE invoke; not API-entry evidence

fields._read_contribution: None until raw BOOL/count pair is defined; then exact uint count incl0; raw scalar/count remain authority
fields._read_fold_phase: pending|applying|committed; pending is NOT a zero-byte observation

fields._accounting_fault: None or first original BaseException reference; failure latch, NOT an eligibility/verified flag

stops: No implementation or subject import/test execution authorized by this design.
Stop before coding if private fault boundary/projection semantics or instrumentation protocol remains ambiguous.
No failure may erase first raw assignment, doublefold bytes, guess unknown ownership/count0, resume work after fault or reset Origin.
Any changed public field/schema/oracle/cap or new public test hook needs a separate reviewed decision.
Old profile FAILED and independent whole-check INCOMPLETE_TIMEOUT remain unchanged.

steps: Existing work/hard and quota guards run before allocation/dispatch. Ri uses private reserved-read count; global C uses len(canonical_calls).
Prepare CallState and append to canonical ordinal list. Wrap indexing in BaseException catch.
Run _index_reserved_call; only if it completes set call.invoked and perform injected binding.

A registration fault after append leaves a reserved UNENTERED record: no scalar/count facts, invocation=False and read_count_unknown=False. Counter/pointer may be partial but owner quarantines work; no retry or guessed close.
Validate exact owner/ref/ordinal and raw value domain with no global scan.
Within one BaseException envelope, assign first raw cell BEFORE any derived cache/state/aux operation; identical re-store preserves cell.
For Read scalar/count run _fold_read_fact; partial pair retains None, complete pair contributes once including known0.

Only afterward allow auxiliary flags or caller postclock. On interruption at ANY fold point, including after committed helper return, retain raw fact, same original error and stopped status; no more noncleanup work.
Multiple cache assignments are NOT assumed atomic; applying may remain partial.
The exception envelope latches the failure; failed folding is NEVER retried or repaired for work.
Already committed identical facts are no-ops only while healthy. A postcommit error still quarantines work; no second add.

Read work getter read_known refuses unhealthy cache. Snapshot/packet/negative cleanup reporting instead derives canonical known facts in a named single-pass report window. Repeated reports do not install caches or permit resume.
handle and _close inspect the pre-registered canonical open/close pointer and its raw scalar directly, with ordinal identity checks; wrapper/aux/cache outcome cannot erase ownership or known closure.

Open/close display hints are NOT authority. Public reported open/close state and known outcomes derive from canonical reservation/invocation/raw facts, preserving not-dispatched-deadline reservation state where applicable.

A pointer registration fault occurs before that operation can invoke, so cannot hide a returned handle. Existing known handles still get the same once-only original-hardclock cleanup; unknown/unentered handles are never guessed/closed.
Close rights stay consumed on unknown/failed close; cleanup/report does not heal accounting or grant completion.
